_comment: DATA-BACKFILL APPLY CHECKS. A migration whose whole effect is UPDATE/INSERT/DELETE declares no object, so its apply-state lives in the ROWS and no generic catalog check can read it. Each entry states how THAT file's effect is observed. kinds: evidence (ok = the file left a trace of itself -> APPLIED) · invariant (ok = the state it enforces holds today -> HOLDS; it cannot prove the file ran, only that nothing it fixed is broken) · superseded (a later migration rewrote the same rows) · unverifiable (ok = the reason still holds; false means this declaration is STALE and must be re-derived). `--self-test` FAILS if a data-only migration has no entry, an entry names a file that is not data-only, or a superseded_by file does not exist. First measured 2026-09-11 by hand, then declared here so nobody has to measure it again.

20260608_advert_channels_config.sql.means: every social_media module row carries the advert_channels key it added
20260608_advert_channels_config.sql.sql: (SELECT count(*) > 0 AND bool_and(config ? 'advert_channels') FROM business_modules WHERE module_key = 'social_media')
